sources.title: JLCPCB Rigid PCB Capabilities
relevant_sections: Traces: minimum width/space (1 oz), multilayer 0.09/0.09mm; 2 oz multilayer 0.15/0.15mm
Drilling: preferred minimum via hole 0.2mm; extra cost for 0.1/0.15mm holes, or 0.2/0.25mm holes with diameter below 0.45mm
sources.interpretation: 0.10/0.10mm within listed 1oz multilayer capability. 0.45/0.20mm is not below the stated diameter threshold; price not quoted. Final PCB DFM and via-in-pad process not established by this routing qualification.
